_readme: Every setting this theme reads. To set up a new site, copy this whole file into the site's site.json in Four51 and fill in the blanks - or keep only the keys you change, since anything left out keeps the value shown here. It must stay valid JSON: keep the outer { } and the commas (paste it into a JSON validator if the site looks unconfigured; the browser console also warns). Blank values ("") and blank list slots are ignored, so unfilled slots are harmless. null clears text the theme shows by default (e.g. "eyebrow": null). Sections merge one level deep; lists replace the default list whole. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. See THEME-DEVELOPMENT-NOTES.md, 'Per-site branding: app/site.json'.
_help_name: name: leave blank. The header shows the company logo uploaded in Four51 if there is one, otherwise the buyer (company) name as text - and the footer and browser tab use the buyer name. Only set name to override the buyer name, or for the login page, which appears before any buyer is known and otherwise says "Storefront". logo.url overrides the uploaded logo. favicon: URL of a .png/.ico; blank keeps storefrontfavicon.ico.

logo._help: url: overrides the company logo uploaded in Four51 - leave blank to use that logo, or the buyer name as text when none is uploaded. alt: the logo's alt text.

welcome._help: Pop-up shown after sign-in. frequency: "day" = once a day per customer (default), "login" = once per sign-in, "once" = once per message; editing the eyebrow, heading or text shows it again under any of them. active: true to turn it on, false to turn it off - it also needs a heading or text. image: optional photo shown beside the copy. One button: fill in primaryButtonText and leave secondaryButtonText blank. Button urls: "#shop", "#story", "#faq" or "#contact" scroll there; blank just closes the pop-up (e.g. "Got it"); a site route (order, favoriteproducts) or full https:// link goes there, https:// in a new tab.
welcome._frequencyOptions: Options for frequency: "day" = once a day per customer, "login" = once each time they sign in, "once" = one time per message. Changing the eyebrow, heading or text shows it again with any option.

announcement._help: messages: short lines for the dark bar above the header, e.g. ["Free shipping on orders over $75"]. Empty hides the bar. Phones show the first line only.

hero._help: image: 2400x1360 photo; mobileImage: 1200x1800 used below 768px (blank reuses image). Without an image the tinted placeholder shows. headingItalic: italic text after heading. buttonHref: 'catalog' or '#shop' scrolls to the shop, anything else is a link. showButton: true/false. secondaryButtonText: outlined button to the story section, only shown when story.heading is set.
hero.heading: Gear your team for the season ahead.
hero.subheading: New apparel, drinkware and print kits, priced for your group.

trust._help: items: up to four short lines under the hero, e.g. ["Free shipping over $75", "30-day returns", "Secure checkout", "Ships in 3 business days"]. Icons go by position: truck, returns, lock, clock. The first two also appear under Add to cart in one-product mode. Empty hides the strip.

shop._help: categoryInteropID: the Four51 category the shop lists (first 12 products) - set this per site. Blank falls back to the Featured category. With exactly one product the shop shows it as a product detail instead of a grid.
shop.heading: The Collection

story._help: The About section: image + copy. heading is required - blank hides the section and the header's About link. paragraphs: one string per paragraph. linkText: link that scrolls to the shop; null hides it.

faq._help: items: [{"question": "...", "answer": "..."}]. No items hides the section and the header's FAQ link. email: shown after intro under the heading; blank hides that line.
faq.heading: Questions, answered.

contact._help: Green band above the footer (the header's Contact link): these details plus a short name/email/message form. Send opens the customer's email app addressed to email, with their message filled in - the theme has no server to send mail itself. Blank email hides the form and the 'Email us at' line. null hides any line.
contact.heading: Any questions?
contact.text: Questions or need help with an order? Need general site support?
contact.hoursNote: Feel free to contact us outside of these hours and one of our team members will respond as soon as possible!
contact.subject: Website message

footer._help: On every page. blurb: short line under the store name. columns: [{"heading": "Help", "links": [{"label": "FAQ", "url": "#faq"}]}] - #shop, #story, #faq and #contact scroll in-page; mailto:, tel:, site routes (order, contactus) and full URLs also work. legalLinks: [{"label": "Privacy", "url": "https://..."}] in the bottom row. Setting columns or legalLinks replaces the default list whole.

login._help: createAccountUrl: where 'Need an account?' on the login page goes. Blank uses the built-in signup at /admin, which needs the site to give anonymous visitors a temp session; otherwise paste the site's Four51 AutoLogon link.

theme._help: accent: brand colour for buttons, links and badges (needs 4.5:1 contrast both as text on #F4F1EC and behind white text); accentDark: hover shade, blank derives it. fontFamily / displayFontFamily: body sans and heading serif family names; fontUrl: a stylesheet that loads them (e.g. a Google Fonts URL) - a family name alone loads nothing.

shipping._help: allowedDomesticMethods / allowedInternationalMethods: shipping method names the checkout may offer (exact names as Four51 returns them, case-insensitive); empty = no restriction. A name matching nothing empties the dropdown and logs a warning. domesticCountries: country codes counted as domestic. freeShippingThreshold: order subtotal for free shipping as a number (75, not "$75") - drives the cart drawer's progress bar only; 0 hides the bar.
